title: Koku Universe as a Design Principle for 3D Bio-Fabrication: Geometric Application to Organ Design
abstract: This paper proposes that the geometric structure of the Koku Universe (刻宇宙) is isomorphic to the design principle of three-dimensional additive manufacturing (3D printing). While the universe advances by breaking through Koku planes, a 3D printer builds form by stacking Koku planes — the inverse operation of the same geometry. CT scanning is interpreted as the visualization of Koku planes. Organ design is defined as the optimization of Koku planes T=(t1,t2) to maximize Genki dance density V=N/D. The optimal organ is the geometric structure that maximizes N (vital motion: blood flow, neural transmission, cellular activity) and minimizes D (friction, resistance, pathology). Body design and civilizational design are described by the same equation. Subtitle: 刻宇宙と三次元生体設計の接続——臓器デザインへの幾何学的応用
keywords: Koku Universe, 刻宇宙, 3D Printing, Bio-Fabrication, Organ Design, Genki, V=N/D, Tendo Economics, 天道経済学, GKU Theory, Geometric Framework

title: Koku Universe and Genki Dance Theory: A Geometric Framework for Civilizational Motion
abstract: This paper proposes the Koku Universe (刻宇宙) as a geometric structure in which Koku planes T=(t1,t2) exist perpendicular to the direction of motion n. On each Koku plane, Genki particles G=(x,y,z) perform a dance. The universe advances by breaking through each plane in the perpendicular direction (n⊥T). IceCube neutrino detections are interpreted as observable moments of this plane-breaking. The density of the Genki dance is expressed as V=N/D, the core equation of Tendo Economics (天道経済学). This is a thought-in-progress record dated June 3, 2026. Subtitle: 刻面上で元気が踊る——文明運動の幾何学的構造

title: ISP BL Lac X-ray Bright AGN Survey: Class-H Spectral Hardening and IceCube GOLD Neutrino Event Temporal Correlation
abstract: Complete cross-match of 242 ISP BL Lac X-ray bright AGN sources with IceCube GOLD high-significance neutrino events. Analysis includes Class-H spectral hardening source classification, temporal correlation window ±30 days, and Poisson significance testing. Identifies 1 Class-H source (1WGA J0506.6-0857, p=0.03739) within GOLD observation period.
keywords: IceCube, BL Lac, neutrino astronomy, X-ray AGN, Class-H sources, high-energy astrophysics, GOLD events

title: Class-H ISP Blazars Show Temporal Coincidence with IceCube Gold Neutrino Events: ISP BL Lac 242-Source Survey with ΔP_間 Framework Validation
abstract: Comprehensive temporal correlation analysis between IceCube GOLD neutrino alerts (62 events, 2019-2025) and Swift-XRT observations of 242 ISP BL Lac objects from 4LAC-DR3 catalog. This study applies the Class-H/Class-S spectral hardening classification framework derived from ΔP_間 hypothesis (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19803698). Results: Class-H objects (spectral hardening type, n=1) show zero detections of GOLD coincidences within ±30-day temporal windows. Poisson test p=1.0000. Findings are consistent with ΔP_間 theory predictions on interconnection amplification at 'ma no kotoba' junction states. This represents the first automated multi-source ISP Blazar neutrino correlation study with permanent DOI record from zero-budget independent research.
keywords: IceCube, BL Lac objects, ISP blazars, neutrino astrophysics, temporal correlation, Class-H spectral hardening, ΔP_間 hypothesis, Swift-XRT, 4LAC-DR3, multi-messenger astronomy, V=N/D framework

title: Bronze-to-GOLD Escalation Pattern in IceCube Neutrino Alerts: Precursor Emission from ISP BL Lac Candidates
abstract: A Bronze-to-GOLD Escalation (BGE) pattern is identified in IceCube 2026 April-May alerts. FAR decreased monotonically: 2.04 to 0.504 to 0.17 per year over 30 days. Among 347 ISP BL Lac objects surveyed in 4LAC-DR3, 4FGL J2245.9+1544 (17.8 sigma, gamma-index=1.987) is identified as Priority-1 neutrino source candidate. The BGE pattern is proposed as a precursor diagnostic tool. ORCID: 0009-0006-2290-6593. TheYKHC Independent Research Institute.

title: A Complete X-ray Spectral Survey of ISP BL Lac Objects in the 4LAC-DR3 High-Confidence Catalog: Evidence for a Rare Spectral Hardening Class
abstract: We present the first complete X-ray spectral survey of all 347 ISP BL Lac objects in the 4LAC-DR3 high-confidence catalog using archival Swift-XRT data. Of 347 targets, 242 had sufficient data, yielding 220 Class-S and 14 Class-H objects. Only 1WGA J0506.6-0857 exhibits statistically significant spectral hardening (p=0.037, beta=2.11). Results are interpreted under the delta-P_Ma Hypothesis (Katayama 2026). ORCID: 0009-0006-2290-6593 | TheYKHC Independent Research Institute
keywords: ISP BL Lac, Swift-XRT, X-ray spectral survey, 4LAC-DR3, IceCube, blazar, spectral hardening

title: The Gold-Price Governance Paradox: Imitation, Amnesia, and the Collapse Threshold of Benchmark-Driven Civilization
abstract: This paper diagnoses a structural pathology in contemporary civilization: the use of benchmark price as the sole arbiter of human value, truth, and social hierarchy. Three interlocking mechanisms — imitation, amnesia, and inverted accountability — are identified as drivers of civilizational collapse. Drawing on Tendo Economics (天道経済学) and the V=N/D framework, this paper proposes not the destruction of this system, but the planting of an alternative axis of value measurement. In the tradition of Hirokichi Hiroi's moral philosophy ('Do not break the evil — plant the sincerity'), a structural prescription is offered: the V=N/D measurement framework, the Hikari currency implementation, and the DOI chain as permanent memory against amnesia.
